name: Tiangong Ultra
summary: Tiangong Ultra is the running version of the Tiangong humanoid platform from the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center. About 1.8 m and 55 kg, it won the world's first humanoid half-marathon in Beijing in April 2025 in 2 hours 40 minutes. The Tiangong line is positioned as an open, electric general-purpose platform.
highlights: Won the April 2025 Beijing humanoid half-marathon (21 km) in about 2 h 40 min, with three battery swaps.
Lightweight build, integrated joints and air cooling to manage joint heat on long runs.
An earlier Tiangong climbed 134 steps continuously, per Mike Kalil.
caveats: Battery swaps were needed during the half-marathon.
No public price or sales channel for the Ultra version.

sources.title: Beijing hosts world's first half-marathon for humanoid robots, Tiangong Ultra wins in two hours 40 minutes
